name: WorkNav
description: Work section sub-navigation: a back-to-index action plus previous/next controls for stepping through the portfolio case studies.

currentPath.description:
Active route used to compute the prev/next disabled state. Defaults to the
current pathname from the router; stories and tests override it to show a
given position in the work sequence.

pages.description: Ordered case-study paths. Defaults to the bundled legacy sequence.

onNavigate.description: Host navigation callback. Defaults to the configured navigation runtime.

disabled.description: Disables every action while host navigation is pending.

ariaRequirements: Wrapped in a nav landmark labelled via aria-label (workNavLabel)
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-16 beta->stable: production NextWorkNav now composes WorkNav with the live project registry while retaining prefetch and transition deduplication; required-story AT snapshots and Chromium forced-colors were recaptured.

forbiddenUse: Hardcode a second project sequence in an application wrapper; pass the live ordered pages collection.
Use WorkNav outside portfolio case-study chrome.
dense: Work-section sub-navigation: back-to-index plus prev/next stepping for portfolio case-study pages

usage.description: Sub-navigation for the work section. Renders a back-to-work action and previous/next controls that step through the case-study sequence, disabling the edges. Portfolio chrome; site-wide nav lives in SiteHeader.

bestPractices.description: Pass the ordered project registry so navigation stays synchronized with published work.
Use onNavigate when the host needs prefetching, transitions, or navigation deduplication.
Do not infer a next project for an unknown route; both adjacent controls intentionally disable.

anatomy.name: Adjacent actions
anatomy.description: Previous and next case-study controls with edge-state disabling.
